extracted.name: From ALL over
ingredient_lines: 7 ounces lap cheong, Chinese fermented sausage, 4 links
3 tablespoons HP sauce, House of Parliament sauce
instruction_lines: Remove the casing from the lap cheong sausage. Slice into bite sized pieces.
Scramble and when done put on a plate
Put the lap cheong sausage into the pan stirfry for 3 minutes
Slice the hotdogs and add to the sausage fry till the hotdogs get color on them.
Add jalapeño peppers stir fry for 3 minutes
Add the HP sauce mix in well sauté for 3 minutes coating everything. Add to plate.
Add cilantro. Serve hope you enjoy!
